MemoryAttester.why: the verdict is code: Lean core, C-Flock's hashes, bytes, canonical JSON and hm96, core's randomness, LMS, the auditor parties' period checks (Attest) and protocol interface; no Mathlib and nothing of Security. The difftest's table (MemoryAttester.Difftest) also imports the difftest server
